# Hugeicons

## Choosing icons

Use the official catalog at https://hugeicons.com/icons to find and select all interface icons for this project. Prefer the free Stroke Rounded style for consistency. Do not substitute hand-drawn icons or another icon library.

Store the selected SVGs in `layouts/partials/icons/`, record the original Hugeicons export name in each file, and preserve the applicable license. Use the `nav-icon.html` partial to render them.

## Source and license

The inline SVG files in `layouts/partials/icons/` were exported from the local `@hugeicons/core-free-icons` package, version 4.2.2. Each file records the original export name. Only the required Stroke Rounded icons are included; building Hugo does not require npm or network access.

Source: https://github.com/hugeicons/hugeicons

License: MIT. The upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE.md` in this directory. The free package's licensing is also documented at https://hugeicons.com/docs/faqs/license-questions.
